Fast Updates for Safe Journeys: Act Now, Pack Smart

This is a reminder from the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways that animal comfort takes priority the moment plans change. If you are traveling with Basil or managing a handoff between crew, flag any delay, temperature shift, or handling concern right away so the welfare coordinator can review needs and adjust arrangements with care. Sara Martin and Lucas Patel, if you receive last-minute route updates, keep communication prompt, respectful, and plain; our team can respond faster when details arrive early.

<<FACT F002>> Please route requests through the desk channel and include clear notes on your animal's routine and any sensitivities. When in doubt, choose stability over novelty: familiar items, quiet attention, and steady guidance. If you are a traveler, arrive with essentials organized and time buffers in mind so staff can complete checks without rushing. The desk welcomes questions in a warm professional tone, and we expect immediate follow-through from all parties involved.
